posts.name: darkroydante
posts.cooked:
Got her.

Gloomweaver flipped. 3 hero game. Vis at 7 HP in cocoon. Realm of Imbued Vitality Sucks.

Gloomweaver had all kinds of cultists (2 of which had both copies out, so 5 cultist targets total) 5 zombies, 3 relics in play. Environment had Bubbles and 2 Portal Fiends.

Visionary had Cocoon, Demoralization, Twist the Ether on herself and Mental Divergence. On her turn, she Demoralized, which killed nothing. Then she used Psychic Maelstrom to kill the Zealot, then both Diciples, then both Ronways, then all 5 zombies, then Gloomweaver. Unlock, game end screen.

posts.cooked:
Damn it! Got Gloomweaver flipped, down to 1 hit point, and fully set up... and an imbued vitality came up, followed by a vast following that got TWO cursed acolytes, sweeping the board of all ongoings, equipments, and heroes alike.

 

Pro tip: Put Visionary last in turn order, so the environment/villain won't get a chance to disrupt your plans when you're almost perfectly setup. (Also next time I'm bringing wraith to just infrared gloomweaver to get his relics out faster.)
